types.name: Config
docs: Platform-wide settings. Only ever read when a *new* pool is created: live
pools carry their own frozen copy of the terms, so nothing an admin does
later can change the deal an existing locker agreed to.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination stamped into new pools' `treasury` field.

fields.name: launchlab_platform
docs: IMAGINE's LaunchLab `PlatformConfig`. `launch` creates every coin under
it, so its creator fee (paid to each coin's reward vault) applies.

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: App fee charged by the front-end on routed swaps, in bps of the quote
leg. Advisory: it is enforced when our API builds the transaction, not
by this program. Stored here so the UI and indexer share one source of
truth.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new launches only. Never blocks lock, claim, or unlock.

fields.name: launchlab_platform
docs: IMAGINE's LaunchLab `PlatformConfig`; new launches are created under it.

types.name: FeeDeposited
docs: `kind`: 0 = buy fee, 1 = sell fee, 2 = creator share, 3 = donation.
`amount` is quote base units.

fields.name: supply
docs: Curve shape; LaunchLab validates the combination against the quote's
GlobalConfig (and the platform's curve rule, if it has one).

fields.name: creator_share_bps
docs: Slice of post-treasury inflow routed to the creator, forever.

types.name: Pool
docs: One lock-to-earn vault, keyed by mint.
Rewards are paid in the coin's LaunchLab quote ("pair asset"): native
lamports on `reward_vault` for a WSOL-quoted coin, otherwise quote tokens in
`reward_token_account`, the vault PDA's associated token account. Amounts
below are quote base units either way.
Reward accounting is the MasterChef accumulator: every unit that lands in
the vault is detected by balance diff, split, and spread over
`total_weight`. No instruction can move quote or coins out of a pool except
to the locker, creator, or treasury that earned it.

fields.name: token_vault
docs: Set by `found`; default until then.

fields.name: reward_vault
docs: System-owned PDA `["vault", pool]`. It is the LaunchLab pool's creator,
so the coin's on-chain creator fee is collected here (or in its token
account for a non-SOL quote).

fields.name: token_program
docs: Token program that owns `mint` (Token-2022 for LaunchLab coins).

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The coin's LaunchLab quote: what lockers are paid in.

fields.name: reward_token_account
docs: `ATA(reward_vault, quote_mint, quote_token_program)` for a token quote;
default for WSOL, whose rewards are native lamports on `reward_vault`.

fields.name: launchlab_pool
docs: The coin's LaunchLab `PoolState`, priced for each lock's earnings cap.

fields.name: reward_remainder
docs: Quote received but too small to divide across `total_weight` yet.

fields.name: last_vault_balance
docs: Distributable vault balance as of the last sync (see `reward_balance`).

fields.name: vault_reserve
docs: Lamports parked in `reward_vault` so it stays rent-exempt; never
distributable.

fields.name: undistributed
docs: Lockers' quote that has arrived but is still streaming out.

fields.name: stream_rate
docs: Release rate in `quote units * SCALE` per second.

fields.name: stream_end
docs: When the current release window ends.

fields.name: last_stream_at
docs: Last timestamp the stream was advanced to.

fields.name: founded
docs: The creator's founding lock is in. Locks, deposits and syncs wait for it.

fields.name: reward_capacity
docs: Quote the open locks can still earn in total: the sum of every
`Position::reward_cap`, less what has been paid and what is already
credited to them. Fees beyond it go to the treasury the moment they
arrive or release.

fields.name: shortfall
docs: Quote that left the vault without this program (a quote issuer's
permanent delegate or clawback) and that the treasury's share, the
stream and the remainder could not cover: what the pool owes beyond
what it holds. Repaid first from the next arrivals. See `absorb_loss`.

types.name: PoolCreated
docs: The creator's founding lock opened the pool.

types.name: PoolLaunched
docs: A coin was created on LaunchLab under the IMAGINE platform with this pool's
reward vault as its creator. The pool opens for locks once `found` runs.

types.name: PoolTerms
docs: Immutable economic terms, copied into every pool at creation.

fields.name: reward_stream_secs
docs: Window over which arriving fees are released to lockers.
Fees are not handed out at the instant they land. They stream in
linearly over this window, so a reward share is earned by weight *held
over time* rather than by weight held at one chosen instant. Without it,
anyone could watch fees pile up in the vault, lock a large bag,
trigger the accounting, claim a slice of a backlog they were not present
for, and leave.

fields.name: duration_curve
docs: `CURVE_LINEAR` or `CURVE_SQRT`; see `math::duration_multiplier_bps`.

fields.name: size_tier_bps
docs: Ascending thresholds in bps of total supply. Zero disables a tier.

fields.name: size_bonus_bps
docs: Bonus applied on top of the duration multiplier at each tier, in bps.

types.name: Position
docs: A single lock. A wallet may hold many, each with its own term and weight.

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: Credit line already settled, in `SCALE`-scaled units, not quote units.
Keeping the sub-unit residue here is what makes the pool solvent:
rounding it to whole units would let positions round up
independently until the pool owed more than it holds.

fields.name: reward_cap
docs: The most this lock may ever be paid, in quote base units: its tokens'
quote value when locked (and when grown or extended) times its
multiplier. Compared against `claimed`.

fields.name: renounced
docs: The owner gave up this lock's earnings for good: it keeps its tokens
locked to its end date but holds no weight, so every unit it would
have earned goes to the other lockers. Irreversible.

types.name: Renounced
docs: A lock gave up its earnings for good: its weight left the pool and what it
had accrued went back to the stream for the other lockers.

types.name: RewardCapped
docs: A lock was paid up to its cap and the rest of what it had accrued went to
the treasury.

types.name: RewardsSynced
docs: Emitted on every sync that absorbed new quote, whatever its source: routed
app fees, the on-chain LaunchLab / CPMM creator fee collected by
`collect_creator_fee`, or plain donations. Amounts
are quote base units.

constants.name: METADATA_URI_PREFIX
docs: The only metadata URI `launch` accepts for a coin is
`METADATA_URI_PREFIX + base58(mint) + METADATA_URI_SUFFIX`: the document
the IMAGINE API hosts for that mint, whose website is the coin's IMAGINE
page (`https://imagine.fun/coins/<mint>`).
